The '''Erigorm Bureaucracy''' was the governing body of the planet [[Erigorm]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Bureaucracy was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by representative [[Augin Blaesus]] and was also a part of the [[Rift Alliance]].
